entities.name: stuck on boot logo or automatic repair loop
force power-off by holding power button 15 seconds
discharge residual capacitors by holding power button 20-30 seconds
reinsert battery and reconnect AC adapter
observe if system proceeds past logo
let Windows run Startup Repair automatically
choose Troubleshoot > Advanced options > Startup Repair
contact IT Service Desk for further assistance
verify user identity and device model via Intune or asset database
ask user to perform hard-reset steps and report result
arrange remote session via Teams or request device shipment
connect laptop to AC power and observe LED/fan activity
attempt to boot to BIOS using appropriate key (F2/F10)
check internal drive detection, Secure Boot status, and boot order in BIOS
exit BIOS and attempt normal boot
run built-in diagnostics (Dell ePSA, Lenovo Vantage, HP PC Hardware Diagnostics)
